g.text: Gate passage and oblique tool alignment
Dynamic occlusion at 31.4 s (top), closest arm–frame approach per flight (middle), and tool alignment at 52 s (bottom).
The rust segment joins the nearest surfaces. Teal and ochre show the measured and target tool axes.
